alpha_cutoff.description: MASK cutoff on the exported baked material. Source MASK cutoffs are respected during capture.

atlas_size.description: Square atlas page size; unique cells spill into additional pages, up to 64.

cell_height.description: Atlas cell height including padding, in pixels.

cell_width.description: Atlas cell width including padding, in pixels.

keep.description: Optional mesh to retain unchanged, such as welded trunk and branches.

margin.description: Extra fitted width and tip margins in meters.

max_distance.description: Maximum component attachment distance from a guide path, in meters. Unmatched components fail instead of disappearing.

memory_mb.description: Working memory estimate limit for generated meshes, decoded PNGs, cell raster and one atlas page. Not a total process cap.

output.description: Relative .glb filename. Atlas PNGs and a manifest are exported beside it in a matching .cardbake directory.

padding.description: Transparent gutter and RGB/normal dilation distance in texels; alpha is never dilated.

paths.description: Skeleton whose individual strands guide the fitted cards, in the same coordinate system as source.

planes.description: One fitted strip or two crossed strips per occupied path. Each strip gets its own unique bake cell.

samples.description: Supersampling grid per pixel: 1, 2x2 or 3x3. No random sampling.

segments.description: Longitudinal segments per fitted card; lower values approximate curvature more coarsely.

source.description: Mesh containing only the leaves and fine twigs to replace. Connected components attach to the closest path at their first indexed vertex.

translucency.description: Uniform baked-card diffuse translucency for the existing Blender preview adapter.
